name: Bulgemaxxing

card.summary: Choosing clothing and underwear so the groin area reads as more prominent, as a way of projecting confidence and a more masculine silhouette.

quick.overview:
Bulgemaxxing is a style meta in which men choose garments, such as light-coloured shorts, joggers or fitted underwear, so the outline of the groin is visible. Participants describe it as part of presentation and as a confidence-signalling choice.

No studies have measured whether it changes how attractive someone is perceived to be; claims come from forum anecdotes, and forum members disagree about its effect.
quick.how: Forum posts discuss garment fit and fabric colour, underwear style and a confident posture and walk. Some mention staying lean to improve the silhouette.
quick.risks: Visible bulges can attract unwanted attention, and public decency norms differ by setting. Forum members also disagree on whether the approach helps.

lead: Bulgemaxxing is a looksmaxxing term for clothing choices that make a man's groin outline more visible, and sometimes more prominent. It belongs to the style metas of the community.

Its roots in menswear are old: the 15th and 16th century codpiece was shaped and padded to emphasise the genitals, peaked in the 1540s and was fading by the 1590s.[3] On looksmax.org, threads describe modern versions, including a guide that lists tight-but-not-baggy trousers, posture and low body fat.[2]

chain: Garment fit, colour and underwear choice
angle.text: Participants use clothing to change the silhouette they present. The benefits are described by forum users and have not been measured in research.

paras: A looksmax.org guide recommends trousers that are loose enough for comfort but not baggy, a wide stride, a lean physique and an upright, confident posture, and also asserts that going without underwear is the key step.[2] Another poster in a discussion thread asked whether a visible bulge helps on dating apps, after noticing a stranger's attention on public transport.[1]
Responses are mixed: some members report women's attention after an accidental visible bulge, while others say the look appears awkward.[2][1]

lore.intro: Bulgemaxxing is discussed in a few looksmax.org threads as a low-effort style tweak.[1]

claims.claim: A visible bulge increases attention from women
claims.believers: Posters describe being stared at while wearing light shorts or joggers and ask if it improves success rates.[1][2]
claims.experts: No published studies have examined this.
